info.name: Retrieve details for an IP address

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address to get details for

items.docs:
Returns the details of the IP address. It will return 422 when requesting details of an inactive IP address.

Required API key permissions: `BreachRisk` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP to update labels for

params.name: labels
params.description: The labels to assign to the IP. You can pass an empty array to remove all labels.

items.docs:
Assign labels to an IP. To remove all labels pass an empty list.

Required API key permissions: `BreachRisk` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

params.name: labels
params.description: Filter result by the provided labels

params.name: page_token
params.description: The `page_token` from a previous request, use this to get the next page of results.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
The value to sort the IPs by

If not specified will default to `ip` and set `sort_desc` to `true`

params.name: sort_desc
params.description: Whether or not to sort the results in descending order

items.docs:
Returns a list of ips for your account.

Required API key permissions: `BreachRisk` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

params.name: ips
params.description: The list of ips to add

params.name: labels
params.description: The labels to assign to the ips when added.

items.docs:
Add a list of custom ips to your account.

Required API key permissions: `BreachRisk` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

params.name: ips
params.description: A comma separated list of ips to remove. Only ips or labels can be specified not both

params.name: labels
params.description: A list of labels whose domains will be removed. All custom IPs with at least one of the provided labels will be removed. Only ips or labels can be specified not both

items.docs:
Remove custom ips from your account.

Required API key permissions: `BreachRisk` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

info.name: Get a list of ip ranges

params.name: labels
params.description: Filter result by the provided labels

params.name: page_token
params.description: The `page_token` from a previous request, use this to get the next page of results.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
The value to sort the IP ranges by

If not specified will default to `num_ips` and set `sort_desc` to `true`

params.name: sort_desc
params.description: Whether or not to sort the results in descending order

items.docs:
Returns a list of ip ranges for your account.

Required API key permissions: `BreachRisk` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)
